outcome.answer: Several papers describe ways to move from dense retrieval toward sparse representations. Latent Terms decomposes dense retriever representations into sparse, BM25-ready features without retrieval-specific training [2]. LACONIC instead trains learned sparse retrievers to approach dense-model effectiveness with lower index memory [1]. Sparse Coverage converts local span embeddings into sparse center-based representations for patent search [5], while SPLARE uses sparse autoencoders to create multilingual latent retrieval features [7]. For product search, PROSPER uses LLMs to produce sparse representations and reports recall comparable to advanced dense retrievers [6].
